pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular sub-polygonal dark brown regions. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients and rounded vertices. Spatial area is highest at the center of the torso and decreases slightly toward the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, light cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a dense lattice. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is narrow and consistent across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency bristled silhouette along the upper neck, created by short, dense mane hairs.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple localized sites of textural disruption and light-colored depigmentation on the upper shoulder and neck base, characterized by exposed skin and loss of pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active cutaneous abrasions and raw tissue lesions localized on the upper right shoulder and mid-neck regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of seven visible oxpeckers (Buphagus sp.) clinging to the hide along the dorsal ridge, neck, and upper flank.
